title: List of S&P 600 companies
wikitext:
{{Short description|none}}

The [[S&P SmallCap 600]] (S&P 600) [[stock market index]], maintained by [[S&P Dow Jones Indices]], comprises the common stocks of 600 [[Market capitalization|small-cap]], mostly American, companies. Although called the "S&P 600", the index contains 603 stocks because it includes two share classes of stock from three of its component companies (Central Garden & Pet Company, Clearway Energy and [[Under Armour]]).

Stocks here are cross referenced with the following index funds to compose the list:
*Vanguard S&P Small-Cap 600 ETF ({{NYSE Arca|VIOO}})<ref>{{cite web |url = https://investor.vanguard.com/etf/profile/portfolio/VIOO/portfolio-holdings |title= Vanguard S&P Small-Cap 600 Portfolio Holdings |publisher= Vanguard  |access-date=April 9, 2021}}</ref>
*SPDR Portfolio S&P 600 Small Cap ETF ({{NYSE Arca|SPSM}})<ref>{{cite web |url = https://www.ssga.com/us/en/institutional/etfs/funds/spdr-portfolio-sp-600-small-cap-etf-spsm |title = SPDR Portfolio S&P 600 Small Cap ETF Holdings |publisher = State Street Global Advisors |access-date = April 9, 2021}}</ref>
*iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF ({{NYSE Arca|IJR}})<ref>{{cite web |url = https://www.ishares.com/us/products/239774/ishares-core-sp-smallcap-etf |title = iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF Portfolio |publisher = iShares by Blackrock |access-date = April 9, 2021}}</ref>
These index funds may be reconstituted at different intervals resulting in a small difference in holdings.

extract:
The S&P SmallCap 600 (S&P 600) stock market index, maintained by S&P Dow Jones Indices, comprises the common stocks of 600 small-cap, mostly American, companies. Although called the "S&P 600", the index contains 603 stocks because it includes two share classes of stock from three of its component companies (Central Garden & Pet Company, Clearway Energy and Under Armour).
Stocks here are cross referenced with the following index funds to compose the list:

Vanguard S&P Small-Cap 600 ETF (NYSE Arca: VIOO)
SPDR Portfolio S&P 600 Small Cap ETF (NYSE Arca: SPSM)
iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF (NYSE Arca: IJR)
These index funds may be reconstituted at different intervals resulting in a small difference in holdings.
